column1: # descriptions.tsv -- what each file and folder MEANS.
# The filesystem already knows what exists, how big it is and when it changed.
# This file holds the half it cannot know. build_index.py joins the two.
# FORMAT  five TAB-separated fields, no quoting:
# pattern      fnmatch glob on the path relative to Implementation/, with
#              forward slashes. "foo/**" matches the folder and everything in it.
# kind         RAW    source data, never edited
#              OUTPUT generated by a script; delete and re-run to rebuild
#              CACHE  expensive intermediate, regenerable but slow
#              DOC    written for a human to read
# status       current | superseded | archived | external | raw
# produced_by  the script that creates it, or blank
# description  one line, written for someone who has never seen the project
# LAST RULE WINS, so order matters: put folder-wide rules first and let
# A file that matches nothing is reported as UNDESCRIBED rather than skipped.
